该数据集包含运动和想象任务的脑电记录，可用于 BCI 评估。
适合作为非侵入式分类流水线的基准数据集。
bullets_en: PhysioNet hosts the EEG Motor Movement/Imagery Dataset v1.0.0.
It provides motor movement and imagery EEG recordings for BCI evaluation.
Useful as a non-invasive benchmark dataset for classification pipelines.

bullets_zh: MOABB v1.7.1 在无法访问 NEMAR 时仍可使用本地缓存的上游数据集数据。
该版本在所有 NEMAR 下载边界捕获泄漏的 httpx.TransportError 异常。
它保留默认 auto provider 回退到各数据集自身下载器。
bullets_en: MOABB v1.7.1 keeps locally cached upstream dataset data usable when NEMAR is unreachable.
It catches leaked httpx.TransportError exceptions at all NEMAR download boundaries.
It preserves the default auto provider fallback to each dataset's own downloader.
items.brief: MOABB v1.7.1修复NEMAR不可达时缓存数据可用性，提升基准可复现性。
items.brief_en: MOABB v1.7.1 keeps cached benchmark data usable when NEMAR is unreachable and preserves provider fallback.
items.raw_excerpt: MOABB 1.7.1 keeps locally cached upstream dataset data usable when NEMAR is unreachable through a proxy or another HTTP transport failure. - Catch leaked `httpx.TransportError` exceptions at all NEMAR download boundaries. - Preserve the default `auto` provider fallback to the dataset's own downloader. See [PR #1171](https://github.com/NeuroTechX/moabb/pull/1171).

bullets_zh: MOABB v1.6.0于2026年8月26日发布，包含68次提交、81条更新日志和21位贡献者。
本次更新扩展了基准数据集覆盖范围，并改进EEG BCI评测文档与示例。
其意义在于MOABB是非侵入式BCI算法可复现比较的标准开放注册库。
bullets_en: MOABB v1.6.0 was released on 2026-08-26 with 68 commits, 81 changelog entries, and 21 credited contributors.
The update expands benchmark dataset coverage and improves documentation/examples for EEG BCI evaluation.
It matters because MOABB is a standard open registry for reproducible comparison of non-invasive BCI algorithms.
items.brief: MOABB v1.6.0更新EEG-BCI基准数据集与评测工具，便于复现比较。
items.brief_en: MOABB v1.6.0 updates EEG-BCI benchmark datasets and evaluation tools for reproducible comparisons.

items.title_en: [NeuroTechX/moabb] Derive AcquisitionMetadata.n_channels from channel_types instead of storing it (#1166)
bullets_zh: MOABB提交#1166修改AcquisitionMetadata，使n_channels由channel_types派生。
该变更移除了可能与channel_types不一致的重复字段。
它影响存储值不一致的目录数据集，包括147个中的34个。
bullets_en: MOABB commit #1166 changes AcquisitionMetadata so n_channels is derived from channel_types.
The change removes a duplicated field that could disagree with channel_types.
It affects catalogued datasets where the stored value was inconsistent, including 34 of 147 cases.
items.brief: MOABB提交修复通道数元数据不一致，提升数据集目录可靠性。
items.brief_en: MOABB commit fixes inconsistent channel-count metadata, improving dataset catalog reliability.
items.raw_excerpt: Derive AcquisitionMetadata.n_channels from channel_types instead of storing it (#1166) AcquisitionMetadata stored n_channels next to channel_types, which describes the same fact.
